sentences.text: In the water, a life jacket is the difference between surviving and drowning.
Cold water shock makes people gasp and inhale water in the first minute, which is why so many drownings happen to people who could swim.
A useful guide is one, ten, one: about one minute of cold shock, ten minutes of meaningful movement before muscles fail, and about an hour before hypothermia causes unconsciousness in cold water.
Florida’s water is warmer, which buys more time, but not unlimited time.
Alone, hold the HELP position with knees to chest and arms crossed.
Stay with the boat if it floats, and don’t try to swim for distant shore.
